name: flex your weather [🔊]
desc:
in this game you can flex your weather and temperature to other players. The cloud above player heads displays the weather in their area, so if it rains, the cloud will also rain. 
change your settings to optimize gameplay.

😎 GROUP MEMBERS GET 25% MONEY BOOST 😎

changelog
- halloweeeeen 🎃

HOW DOES THIS GAME WORK?
We got to know your country from the experience translation service. We then use an open-source weather service (API) called Open-Meteo to get weather data based on your country
